```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(jsonlite)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parameters
# Point this at the folder holding ball-events/, ball-positions/, etc.
# It is auto-detected when this file sits inside the challenge folder.
find_data_root <- function() {
  env <- Sys.getenv("SMT_DATA_ROOT", unset = "")
  if (env != "") return(normalizePath(env, mustWork = FALSE))
  for (cand in c(".", "..", "../..")) {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(cand, "ball-events"))) {
      return(normalizePath(cand, mustWork = FALSE))
    }
  }
  stop("Could not find the data. Set SMT_DATA_ROOT.")
}

DATA_ROOT <- find_data_root()
SHOWCASE  <- "y1_d122_IOL_VAS"   # the game the explorer replays
N_GAMES   <- 250                 # games used to FIT the models
```

```{r}
#| label: constants
#| include: false

FT_S_TO_MPH        <- 0.681818
OUTS_PER_HALF      <- 3L
RUBBER_TO_PLATE_FT <- 60.5
COMMIT_POINT_FT    <- 23.8       # where a hitter must commit (~175 ms out)
GRAVITY_FT_S2      <- 32.174
AVG_SPEED_FACTOR   <- 0.93       # a pitch loses ~8% of its speed en route

BASE_STATES <- c("___", "1__", "_2_", "12_", "__3", "1_3", "_23", "123")
POS_ABBR <- c("1"="P","2"="C","3"="1B","4"="2B","5"="3B","6"="SS",
              "7"="LF","8"="CF","9"="RF","10"="BAT","11"="R1","12"="R2","13"="R3")

EVENT <- c(PITCH=1, ACQUIRED=2, THROW=3, HIT_INTO_PLAY=4, END_OF_PLAY=5,
           PICKOFF=6, ACQUIRED_UNK=7, THROW_UNK=8, DEFLECTION=9,
           DEFLECTION_WALL=10, HOME_RUN=11, BOUNCE=16)

# Codes meaning the ball stayed live after contact. A foul shares code 4 with a
# live batted ball, so this set is how the two are told apart.
LIVE_BALL_CODES <- unname(EVENT[c("ACQUIRED","THROW","ACQUIRED_UNK","THROW_UNK",
                                  "DEFLECTION","DEFLECTION_WALL","BOUNCE")])

THEME <- list(ink="#12181f", panel="#161f2b", panel2="#22303f", text="#ffffff",
              muted="#9fb0c0", grass="#0b6b3a", gold="#ffc72c",
              accent="#c8102e", home="#2f80ed", away="#f2994a")

theme_scoreboard <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = THEME$ink, colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = THEME$panel, colour = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = THEME$panel2),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      text = element_text(colour = THEME$text),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = THEME$muted),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 4),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = THEME$muted),
      legend.position = "bottom")
}

# What this document does

The SMT tables record **base occupancy** but not outs, runs or the score. Win
Probability Added and Leverage Index are functions of

$$(\text{inning},\ \text{half},\ \text{outs},\ \text{base state},\ \text{score differential})$$

so neither can be computed until that game state is reconstructed. This document
does the whole chain in R, in one file:

1. **Reconstruct play-by-play** from base-occupancy transitions and the event stream
2. **Fit Run Expectancy and Win Probability**, then compute **WPA and Leverage in parallel**
3. **Build a clickable explorer** — pick any play and watch it, with the numbers that explain it

---

# 1. Reconstructing play-by-play

For each half-inning we walk the at-bats and apply an accounting identity.
Everyone on base before the play, plus the batter, must end up in exactly one of
three places — still on base, across the plate, or retired:

$$|B| + 1 = |A| + \text{runs} + \text{outs}$$

$|B|$ and $|A|$ are read from `lineups`; whether the batter reached comes from the
*next* at-bat's occupancy. The half-inning must total three outs, which closes
the system.

Three details matter, each found by checking output against real baseball rates:

- **Count the batter once.** Subtracting him from both sides produced a 31–28 final score.
- **Skip the identity on the last at-bat of a half-inning.** With no observed "after" state, runners left on base look identical to runs.
- **Only the terminal play decides the outcome.** A foul shares event code 4 with a live batted ball, so a walk after a foul was being recorded as a single.

```{r}
#| label: reconstruction-helpers

base_state_code <- function(on1, on2, on3) {
  as.integer(!is.na(on1)) + 2L * as.integer(!is.na(on2)) + 4L * as.integer(!is.na(on3))
}

describe_state <- function(base_state, outs) {
  on1 <- bitwAnd(base_state, 1L) > 0
  on2 <- bitwAnd(base_state, 2L) > 0
  on3 <- bitwAnd(base_state, 4L) > 0
  bases <- case_when(
    !on1 & !on2 & !on3 ~ "bases empty",
    on1 & on2 & on3    ~ "bases loaded",
    on1 & on3          ~ "runners on the corners",
    on1 & on2          ~ "runners on first and second",
    on2 & on3          ~ "runners on second and third",
    on1                ~ "a runner on first",
    on2                ~ "a runner on second",
    TRUE               ~ "a runner on third")
  outs_txt <- case_when(outs == 0 ~ "nobody out", outs == 1 ~ "one out",
                        TRUE ~ "two outs")
  paste0(bases, ", ", outs_txt)
}

# TRUE if the terminal play was a batted ball that stayed live (not a foul).
is_live_contact <- function(term_codes) {
  if (length(term_codes) == 0) return(FALSE)
  if (EVENT[["HOME_RUN"]] %in% term_codes) return(TRUE)
  if (!(EVENT[["HIT_INTO_PLAY"]] %in% term_codes)) return(FALSE)
  hit_idx <- which(term_codes == EVENT[["HIT_INTO_PLAY"]])[1]
  any(term_codes[-seq_len(hit_idx)] %in% LIVE_BALL_CODES)
}

# Baseball physics bounds how many runners can score, which stops
# pinch-runner substitutions from being mistaken for runs.
max_plausible_runs <- function(kind, on1, on2, on3) {
  n1 <- as.integer(!is.na(on1)); n2 <- as.integer(!is.na(on2))
  n3 <- as.integer(!is.na(on3)); on_base <- n1 + n2 + n3
  switch(kind,
         "home_run" = on_base + 1L, "triple" = on_base,
         "double"   = n1 + n2 + n3, "single" = n2 + n3,
         "walk_hbp" = if (n1 && n2 && n3) 1L else 0L,
         "out"      = n3, "fielders_choice" = n3, on_base)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: reconstruct-fn

reconstruct_game <- function(game_string) {

  lu <- lineups %>% filter(game_string == !!game_string)
  if (nrow(lu) == 0) return(NULL)

  ev <- ball_events %>%
    filter(game_string == !!game_string) %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(across(c(play_per_game, timestamp, player_id, ball_eventcode),
                  as.numeric))

  pa <- lu %>% filter(!coalesce(is_pickoff, FALSE))

  ab <- pa %>%
    group_by(inning, half_inning, at_bat) %>%
    summarise(first_play = min(play_per_game), last_play = max(play_per_game),
              n_pitches = n(), batter = first(batter), pitcher = first(pitcher),
              on_1b = first(on_1b), on_2b = first(on_2b), on_3b = first(on_3b),
              home_team = first(home_team), away_team = first(away_team),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(half_order = as.integer(half_inning == "Bottom")) %>%
    arrange(inning, half_order, at_bat)

  plays_by_ab <- pa %>%
    group_by(inning, half_inning, at_bat) %>%
    summarise(plays = list(play_per_game), .groups = "drop")

  out_rows <- list()

  for (key in unique(paste(ab$inning, ab$half_order))) {
    grp <- ab %>% filter(paste(inning, half_order) == key) %>% arrange(at_bat)
    n <- nrow(grp); if (n == 0) next
    recs <- vector("list", n)

    ## pass 1 -- batter outcome and departures
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      r   <- grp[i, ]
      nxt <- if (i < n) grp[i + 1, ] else NULL

      before <- c(r$on_1b, r$on_2b, r$on_3b); before <- before[!is.na(before)]
      after  <- if (!is.null(nxt)) {
        a <- c(nxt$on_1b, nxt$on_2b, nxt$on_3b); a[!is.na(a)]
      } else character(0)

      dest <- NA_integer_
      if (!is.null(nxt)) {
        dest <- 0L
        if (!is.na(nxt$on_1b) && nxt$on_1b == r$batter) dest <- 1L
        else if (!is.na(nxt$on_2b) && nxt$on_2b == r$batter) dest <- 2L
        else if (!is.na(nxt$on_3b) && nxt$on_3b == r$batter) dest <- 3L
      }

      plays <- plays_by_ab %>%
        filter(inning == r$inning, half_inning == r$half_inning,
               at_bat == r$at_bat) %>% pull(plays) %>% unlist()

      term_codes <- ev %>%
        filter(play_per_game == max(plays)) %>%
        arrange(timestamp) %>% pull(ball_eventcode)
      live <- is_live_contact(term_codes)

      kind <- if (EVENT[["HOME_RUN"]] %in% term_codes) {
        "home_run"
      } else if (!is.na(dest) && dest > 0) {
        if (!live) "walk_hbp" else switch(as.character(dest), "1"="single",
                                          "2"="double", "3"="triple", "single")
      } else "out"
      if (kind == "home_run") dest <- 4L

      is_last     <- is.null(nxt)
      gone        <- if (is_last) 0L else max(0L, length(before) + 1L - length(after))
      batter_out  <- if (is.na(dest) || dest == 0) 1L else 0L
      runner_gone <- max(0L, gone - batter_out)

      recs[[i]] <- list(
        inning = as.integer(r$inning), half_inning = as.character(r$half_inning),
        at_bat = as.integer(r$at_bat), first_play = as.numeric(r$first_play),
        last_play = as.numeric(r$last_play), n_pitches = as.integer(r$n_pitches),
        batter = as.character(r$batter), pitcher = as.character(r$pitcher),
        home_team = as.character(r$home_team), away_team = as.character(r$away_team),
        on_1b = as.character(r$on_1b), on_2b = as.character(r$on_2b),
        on_3b = as.character(r$on_3b),
        outcome = kind, ball_in_play = live, n_before = length(before),
        batter_out = batter_out, runner_gone = runner_gone, is_last = is_last)
    }

    ## pass 2 -- split departures between runs and outs
    batter_outs <- vapply(recs, function(x) x$batter_out, integer(1))
    avail  <- sum(vapply(recs, function(x) x$runner_gone, integer(1)))
    needed <- min(max(0L, OUTS_PER_HALF - sum(batter_outs)), avail)

    ord <- order(batter_outs == 0,
                 !vapply(recs, function(x) x$ball_in_play, logical(1)))
    runner_outs <- integer(n); remaining <- needed
    for (i in ord) {
      if (remaining <= 0) break
      if (recs[[i]]$outcome == "home_run") next
      take <- min(recs[[i]]$runner_gone, remaining)
      runner_outs[i] <- take; remaining <- remaining - take
    }

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      rec <- recs[[i]]
      if (rec$outcome == "home_run") {
        recs[[i]]$runs <- rec$n_before + 1L; recs[[i]]$outs_on_play <- 0L
      } else if (rec$is_last) {
        used <- sum(vapply(recs[seq_len(i - 1)],
                           function(x) x$outs_on_play, integer(1)))
        recs[[i]]$outs_on_play <- max(0L, OUTS_PER_HALF - used)
        recs[[i]]$runs <- 0L
      } else {
        recs[[i]]$outs_on_play <- batter_outs[i] + runner_outs[i]
        cap <- max_plausible_runs(rec$outcome, rec$on_1b, rec$on_2b, rec$on_3b)
        recs[[i]]$runs <- as.integer(min(max(0L, rec$runner_gone - runner_outs[i]),
                                         cap))
      }
    }

    ## pass 3 -- running outs, clamped so the state can never be illegal
    outs_before <- 0L
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      allowance <- OUTS_PER_HALF - outs_before
      recs[[i]]$outs_on_play <- max(0L, min(recs[[i]]$outs_on_play, allowance))
      recs[[i]]$outs_before  <- min(outs_before, OUTS_PER_HALF - 1L)
      outs_before <- min(OUTS_PER_HALF, outs_before + recs[[i]]$outs_on_play)
      recs[[i]]$base_state_before <- base_state_code(recs[[i]]$on_1b,
                                                     recs[[i]]$on_2b,
                                                     recs[[i]]$on_3b)
    }
    out_rows <- c(out_rows, recs)
  }

  df <- bind_rows(lapply(out_rows, function(x) {
    x$is_last <- NULL; x$batter_out <- NULL; x$runner_gone <- NULL
    as_tibble(x)
  }))

  df <- df %>%
    arrange(inning, as.integer(half_inning == "Bottom"), at_bat) %>%
    mutate(
      game_string = !!game_string,
      batting_team = ifelse(half_inning == "Top", away_team, home_team),
      home_score_after = cumsum(ifelse(half_inning == "Bottom", runs, 0L)),
      away_score_after = cumsum(ifelse(half_inning == "Top", runs, 0L)),
      home_score_before = home_score_after - ifelse(half_inning == "Bottom", runs, 0L),
      away_score_before = away_score_after - ifelse(half_inning == "Top", runs, 0L),
      score_diff_before = ifelse(half_inning == "Top",
                                 away_score_before - home_score_before,
                                 home_score_before - away_score_before),
      situation = paste0(ifelse(half_inning == "Top", "Top ", "Bot "), inning,
                         ", ", describe_state(base_state_before, outs_before)))

  hf <- max(df$home_score_after); af <- max(df$away_score_after)
  # The win-probability target must be complementary: writing this as two strict
  # inequalities marks BOTH sides as losers in a tied game, and the model then
  # learns from contradictory rows. Ties go to the away side.
  df %>% mutate(
    home_final = hf, away_final = af,
    batting_team_won = ifelse(half_inning == "Bottom",
                              as.integer(hf > af), as.integer(af >= hf)))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-reconstruction

all_games <- unique(game_info$game_string)
fit_games <- unique(c(SHOWCASE, head(all_games, N_GAMES)))

# Reconstruction is embarrassingly parallel across games -- each one is
# independent -- so it is spread over the available cores. mclapply falls back
# to a single core on Windows, which is why the worker count is guarded.
n_cores <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L)
if (.Platform$OS.type != "unix") n_cores <- 1L

pbp_list <- parallel::mclapply(fit_games, function(g) {
  tryCatch(reconstruct_game(g), error = function(e) NULL)
}, mc.cores = n_cores)

pbp <- bind_rows(pbp_list)
pbp_showcase <- pbp %>% filter(game_string == SHOWCASE)
```

tibble(
  metric = c("games reconstructed", "plate appearances", "runs per game",
             "hits per game", "walks per game", "plate appearances per game"),
  value = c(n_games, nrow(pbp),
            round(sum(pbp$runs) / n_games, 2),
            round(sum(pbp$outcome %in% c("single","double","triple","home_run")) / n_games, 2),
            round(sum(pbp$outcome == "walk_hbp") / n_games, 2),
            round(nrow(pbp) / n_games, 2)),

) %>% knitr::kable(caption = "Reconstruction checked against real MiLB rates")

---

# 2. WPA and Leverage, computed in parallel

Both metrics are built from the same win-probability model, so they are computed
together in one pass and presented side by side.

```{r}
#| label: run-expectancy

# Run expectancy: average runs from a base/out state to the end of the inning.
re_tbl <- pbp %>%
  arrange(game_string, inning, half_inning, at_bat) %>%
  group_by(game_string, inning, half_inning) %>%
  mutate(runs_rest = rev(cumsum(rev(runs)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(outs_before < OUTS_PER_HALF) %>%
  group_by(base_state_before, outs_before) %>%
  summarise(run_expectancy = mean(runs_rest), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

re_vector <- function(base_state, outs) {
  ref <- setNames(re_tbl$run_expectancy,
                  paste(re_tbl$base_state_before, re_tbl$outs_before))
  out <- unname(ref[paste(base_state, outs)])
  out[is.na(out) | outs >= OUTS_PER_HALF] <- 0
  out
}

re_tbl %>%
  mutate(bases = BASE_STATES[base_state_before + 1],
         outs = paste0(outs_before, ifelse(outs_before == 1, " out", " outs"))) %>%
  select(bases, outs, run_expectancy) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = outs, values_from = run_expectancy) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Run expectancy — falls across outs for every base state")
```

```{r}
#| label: win-probability

wp_features <- function(d) {
  d %>% mutate(
    innings_left = pmax(0, 9 - inning + ifelse(half_inning == "Top", 0.5, 0)),
    is_bottom = as.integer(half_inning == "Bottom"),
    runners_on = as.integer(bitwAnd(base_state_before, 1L) > 0) +
      as.integer(bitwAnd(base_state_before, 2L) > 0) +
      as.integer(bitwAnd(base_state_before, 4L) > 0),
    in_scoring_position = as.integer(bitwAnd(base_state_before, 6L) > 0),
    re_state = re_vector(base_state_before, outs_before),
    score_diff = score_diff_before,
    score_diff_x_innings_left = score_diff_before * innings_left,
    score_diff_per_inning_left = score_diff_before / (innings_left + 1),
    outs = outs_before)
}

# A logistic model rather than an empirical lookup: 250 games cannot fill an
# (inning x base-out x score-margin) grid, and a lookup gives jagged,
# non-monotonic probabilities that look broken on a scoreboard.
wp_model <- glm(
  batting_team_won ~ score_diff + innings_left + score_diff_x_innings_left +
    score_diff_per_inning_left + outs + re_state + is_bottom + runners_on +
    in_scoring_position,
  family = binomial(), data = wp_features(pbp))

predict_wp <- function(d) as.numeric(predict(wp_model, newdata = wp_features(d),
                                             type = "response"))
```

```{r}
#| label: wpa-and-leverage

## ---- WPA -----------------------------------------------------------------
# The half-inning flip matters: after the third out the other team bats, so the
# batting team's win probability becomes the COMPLEMENT of the next state's.
pbp <- pbp %>% arrange(game_string, inning,
                       as.integer(half_inning == "Bottom"), at_bat)
pbp$wp_before <- predict_wp(pbp)

pbp <- pbp %>%
  group_by(game_string) %>%
  mutate(
    .nxt = lead(wp_before),
    .same = lead(half_inning) == half_inning & lead(inning) == inning,
    wp_after = case_when(is.na(.nxt) ~ as.numeric(batting_team_won),
                         .same       ~ .nxt,
                         TRUE        ~ 1 - .nxt),
    wpa = wp_after - wp_before) %>%
  select(-.nxt, -.same) %>%
  ungroup()

## ---- Leverage ------------------------------------------------------------
# Vectorized state transition: apply an outcome to every state at once.
apply_outcome_vec <- function(base_state, outs, kind) {
  n <- length(base_state)
  on1 <- bitwAnd(base_state, 1L) > 0
  on2 <- bitwAnd(base_state, 2L) > 0
  on3 <- bitwAnd(base_state, 4L) > 0
  bits <- function(a, b, c) as.integer(a) + 2L*as.integer(b) + 4L*as.integer(c)

  if (kind %in% c("out", "fielders_choice"))
    return(list(base = base_state, outs = outs + 1L, runs = rep(0L, n)))
  if (kind == "walk_hbp")
    return(list(base = case_when(!on1 ~ bits(TRUE, on2, on3),
                                 !on2 ~ bits(TRUE, TRUE, on3),
                                 TRUE ~ 7L),
                outs = outs, runs = as.integer(on1 & on2 & on3)))
  if (kind == "single")
    return(list(base = bits(TRUE, on1, rep(FALSE, n)), outs = outs,
                runs = as.integer(on2) + as.integer(on3)))
  if (kind == "double")
    return(list(base = rep(2L, n), outs = outs,
                runs = as.integer(on1) + as.integer(on2) + as.integer(on3)))
  if (kind == "triple")
    return(list(base = rep(4L, n), outs = outs,
                runs = as.integer(on1) + as.integer(on2) + as.integer(on3)))
  if (kind == "home_run")
    return(list(base = rep(0L, n), outs = outs,
                runs = 1L + as.integer(on1) + as.integer(on2) + as.integer(on3)))
  list(base = base_state, outs = outs, runs = rep(0L, n))
}

# Leverage = expected |change in win probability| from a state, normalized so an
# average plate appearance is 1.0. Done with ONE prediction per outcome across
# the whole season rather than one per plate appearance -- six model calls
# instead of tens of thousands.
mix <- pbp %>% count(outcome) %>% mutate(p = n / sum(n))
outcome_mix <- setNames(mix$p, mix$outcome)

wp0 <- predict_wp(pbp)
swing_total <- rep(0, nrow(pbp))

for (kind in names(outcome_mix)) {
  st <- apply_outcome_vec(pbp$base_state_before, pbp$outs_before, kind)
  ended <- st$outs >= OUTS_PER_HALF
  nxt <- tibble(
    inning = ifelse(ended & pbp$half_inning == "Bottom", pbp$inning + 1L, pbp$inning),
    half_inning = ifelse(ended, ifelse(pbp$half_inning == "Top", "Bottom", "Top"),
                         pbp$half_inning),
    outs_before = ifelse(ended, 0L, st$outs),
    base_state_before = ifelse(ended, 0L, st$base),
    score_diff_before = ifelse(ended, -(pbp$score_diff_before + st$runs),
                               pbp$score_diff_before + st$runs))
  wp1 <- predict_wp(nxt)
  wp1 <- ifelse(ended, 1 - wp1, wp1)
  swing_total <- swing_total + outcome_mix[[kind]] * abs(wp1 - wp0)
}

pbp <- pbp %>%
  mutate(leverage_index = swing_total / mean(swing_total, na.rm = TRUE),
         clutch_score = 100 * tanh(3 * abs(wpa) * sqrt(pmax(leverage_index, 0))))

pbp_showcase <- pbp %>% filter(game_string == SHOWCASE)
```

```{r}
#| label: model-quality
#| echo: false

p <- predict_wp(pbp); y <- pbp$batting_team_won
li <- pbp$leverage_index[is.finite(pbp$leverage_index)]

bind_rows(
  tibble(metric = "win probability — accuracy", value = round(mean((p >= .5) == (y == 1)), 3)),
  tibble(metric = "win probability — Brier score", value = round(mean((p - y)^2), 3)),
  tibble(metric = "win probability — base rate", value = round(mean(y), 3)),
  tibble(metric = "leverage — mean (1.0 by construction)", value = round(mean(li), 3)),
  tibble(metric = "leverage — 95th percentile", value = round(quantile(li, .95), 2)),
  tibble(metric = "leverage — maximum", value = round(max(li), 2)),
  tibble(metric = "share of plate appearances above 2.0 leverage",
         value = round(mean(li >= 2), 3))
) %>% knitr::kable(caption = "Model quality")
```

## The two metrics, side by side

WPA says *how much a play changed the game*. Leverage says *how much was at
stake before it happened*. Reading them together is what separates a
meaningless three-run homer in a blowout from a game-winning single.

::: {layout-ncol=2}

```{r}
#| label: fig-wpa
#| fig-cap: "Win probability through the showcase game"
#| echo: false

flow <- pbp_showcase %>%
  mutate(wp_home = ifelse(half_inning == "Bottom", wp_after, 1 - wp_after),
         play_index = row_number())

ggplot(flow, aes(play_index, wp_home)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed", colour = THEME$muted) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .5, ymax = pmax(wp_home, .5)), fill = THEME$home, alpha = .35) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmin(wp_home, .5), ymax = .5), fill = THEME$away, alpha = .35) +
  geom_line(colour = THEME$text, linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "WIN PROBABILITY", x = "Plate appearance", y = NULL) +
  theme_scoreboard()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-leverage
#| fig-cap: "Leverage through the same game"
#| echo: false

flow_li <- pbp_showcase %>% mutate(play_index = row_number())

ggplot(flow_li, aes(play_index, leverage_index)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = leverage_index >= 2), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = THEME$muted) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = THEME$accent, `FALSE` = THEME$panel2)) +
  labs(title = "LEVERAGE INDEX", x = "Plate appearance", y = NULL) +
  theme_scoreboard()
```

# 3. The Play Explorer

Every plate appearance of the showcase game, clickable. Selecting one replays it
from the 20 Hz tracking and shows the numbers behind it.

```{r}
#| label: build-play-payload
#| include: false

meta_row <- game_info %>% filter(game_string == SHOWCASE) %>% slice(1)
HOME_TEAM <- meta_row$home_team; AWAY_TEAM <- meta_row$away_team

# --- tracking for every play of the showcase game -------------------------
ball_track <- ball_positions %>%
  filter(game_string == SHOWCASE) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(across(c(play_per_game, timestamp, ball_position_x,
                  ball_position_y, ball_position_z), as.numeric))

player_track <- player_positions %>%
  filter(game_string == SHOWCASE) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(across(c(play_per_game, timestamp, player_id, field_x, field_y),
                as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(player_id <= 13)

events_show <- ball_events %>%
  filter(game_string == SHOWCASE) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(across(c(play_per_game, timestamp, player_id, ball_eventcode),
                as.numeric))

# Frames are trimmed to the live ball and rounded to a tenth of a foot --
# finer precision is invisible at scoreboard scale and triples the file size.
build_track <- function(play) {
  b <- ball_track %>% filter(play_per_game == play) %>% arrange(timestamp)
  if (nrow(b) < 2) return(NULL)
  e <- events_show %>% filter(play_per_game == play)

  t0 <- if (any(e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["PITCH"]])) {
    min(e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["PITCH"]]])
  } else min(b$timestamp)
  t1 <- if (any(e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["END_OF_PLAY"]])) {
    max(e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["END_OF_PLAY"]]]) + 800
  } else max(b$timestamp)

  b <- b %>% filter(timestamp >= t0 - 400, timestamp <= t1)
  if (nrow(b) < 2) return(NULL)
  times <- b$timestamp

  pl <- player_track %>% filter(play_per_game == play)
  players <- list()
  for (pid in sort(unique(pl$player_id))) {
    trk <- pl %>% filter(player_id == pid) %>% arrange(timestamp)
    if (nrow(trk) < 2) next
    players[[as.character(pid)]] <- list(
      x = round(approx(trk$timestamp, trk$field_x, xout = times, rule = 2)$y, 1),
      y = round(approx(trk$timestamp, trk$field_y, xout = times, rule = 2)$y, 1))
  }

  marks <- e %>%
    filter(ball_eventcode %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 16)) %>%
    transmute(t = round(timestamp - times[1]), code = ball_eventcode)

  list(t = round(times - times[1]),
       bx = round(b$ball_position_x, 1), by = round(b$ball_position_y, 1),
       bz = round(b$ball_position_z, 1),
       players = players,
       events = if (nrow(marks)) marks else NULL)
}

play_ids <- sort(unique(pbp_showcase$last_play))
tracks <- list()
for (p in play_ids) {
  tr <- build_track(p)
  if (!is.null(tr)) tracks[[as.character(p)]] <- tr
}

# --- per-play metrics -----------------------------------------------------
speed_of <- function(x, y, ts) {
  dt <- diff(ts) / 1000; d <- sqrt(diff(x)^2 + diff(y)^2)
  s <- ifelse(dt > 0, d / dt, NA_real_); s[is.finite(s)]
}

play_detail <- function(row) {
  play <- row$last_play
  e <- events_show %>% filter(play_per_game == play)
  hit_t <- e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["HIT_INTO_PLAY"]]]
  b <- ball_track %>% filter(play_per_game == play) %>% arrange(timestamp)

  det <- list()

  # Pitch velocity for the deciding pitch
  pt <- e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["PITCH"]]]
  if (length(pt) && nrow(b) >= 3) {
    w <- b %>% filter(timestamp >= min(pt), timestamp <= min(pt) + 800)
    if (nrow(w) >= 3) {
      sp <- sqrt(diff(w$ball_position_x)^2 + diff(w$ball_position_y)^2 +
                   diff(w$ball_position_z)^2) / (diff(w$timestamp) / 1000)
      sp <- sp[is.finite(sp)]
      if (length(sp)) {
        v <- unname(quantile(sp, .9)) * FT_S_TO_MPH
        if (v > 40 && v <= 103) det$pitch_velo <- round(v, 1)
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(hit_t)) {
    th <- min(hit_t)
    w <- b %>% filter(timestamp >= th, timestamp <= th + 400)
    if (nrow(w) >= 3) {
      sp <- sqrt(diff(w$ball_position_x)^2 + diff(w$ball_position_y)^2 +
                   diff(w$ball_position_z)^2) / (diff(w$timestamp) / 1000)
      sp <- sp[is.finite(sp)]
      if (length(sp)) {
        ev_mph <- unname(quantile(sp, .95)) * FT_S_TO_MPH
        if (ev_mph > 20 && ev_mph < 125) det$exit_velo <- round(ev_mph, 1)
      }
      n <- min(4, nrow(w) - 1)
      horiz <- sqrt((w$ball_position_x[n+1] - w$ball_position_x[1])^2 +
                      (w$ball_position_y[n+1] - w$ball_position_y[1])^2)
      if (horiz > 0) det$launch <- round(
        atan2(w$ball_position_z[n+1] - w$ball_position_z[1], horiz) * 180/pi, 1)
    }
    # Carry: distance at the ball's first bounce, not its furthest point --
    # relay throws carry the ball further from home AFTER it lands.
    bp <- b %>% filter(timestamp >= th)
    bounce <- e$timestamp[e$ball_eventcode == EVENT[["BOUNCE"]] & e$timestamp > th]
    if (nrow(bp) >= 3) {
      idx <- if (length(bounce)) which.min(abs(bp$timestamp - min(bounce))) else {
        apex <- which.max(bp$ball_position_z)
        apex + which.min(abs(bp$ball_position_z[apex:nrow(bp)] -
                               bp$ball_position_z[1])) - 1
      }
      idx <- min(max(idx, 1), nrow(bp))
      det$carry <- round(sqrt(bp$ball_position_x[idx]^2 + bp$ball_position_y[idx]^2), 1)
    }

    # Fielder who handled it, and the ground covered
    acq <- e %>% filter(ball_eventcode %in% c(EVENT[["ACQUIRED"]], EVENT[["ACQUIRED_UNK"]]),
                        timestamp >= th, player_id >= 1, player_id <= 9) %>%
      arrange(timestamp)
    if (nrow(acq) && (acq$timestamp[1] - th) / 1000 < 12) {
      fid <- acq$player_id[1]; ta <- acq$timestamp[1]
      trk <- player_track %>% filter(play_per_game == play, player_id == fid) %>%
        arrange(timestamp)
      p0 <- trk %>% filter(timestamp <= th) %>% tail(1)
      p1 <- trk %>% filter(timestamp <= ta) %>% tail(1)
      if (nrow(p0) && nrow(p1)) {
        det$fielder <- unname(POS_ABBR[as.character(fid)])
        det$route_ft <- round(sqrt((p1$field_x - p0$field_x)^2 +
                                     (p1$field_y - p0$field_y)^2), 1)
        det$time_to_ball <- round((ta - th) / 1000, 2)
        sp <- speed_of(trk$field_x, trk$field_y, trk$timestamp)
        if (length(sp)) det$closing_mph <- round(unname(quantile(sp, .9)) * FT_S_TO_MPH, 1)
      }
      thr <- e %>% filter(ball_eventcode %in% c(EVENT[["THROW"]], EVENT[["THROW_UNK"]]),
                          player_id == fid, timestamp >= ta) %>% arrange(timestamp)
      if (nrow(thr)) det$transfer_s <- round((thr$timestamp[1] - ta) / 1000, 2)
    }

    # Batter's run
    bt <- player_track %>% filter(play_per_game == play, player_id == 10,
                                  timestamp >= th) %>% arrange(timestamp)
    if (nrow(bt) >= 4) {
      sp <- speed_of(bt$field_x, bt$field_y, bt$timestamp)
      if (length(sp)) det$sprint_mph <- round(unname(quantile(sp, .95)) * FT_S_TO_MPH, 1)
    }
  }
  det
}

plays_payload <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pbp_showcase)), function(i) {
  r <- pbp_showcase[i, ]
  d <- play_detail(r)
  c(list(
    idx = i - 1L,
    inning = r$inning, half = r$half_inning, batter = r$batter,
    pitcher = r$pitcher, outcome = r$outcome, runs = r$runs,
    outs = r$outs_before, bases = BASE_STATES[r$base_state_before + 1],
    home = r$home_score_after, away = r$away_score_after,
    situation = r$situation,
    wpa = round(r$wpa, 4), leverage = round(r$leverage_index, 2),
    wp_home = round(ifelse(r$half_inning == "Bottom", r$wp_after, 1 - r$wp_after), 4),
    play = r$last_play), d)
})

payload <- list(
  meta = list(home = HOME_TEAM, away = AWAY_TEAM, game = SHOWCASE),
  plays = plays_payload,
  tracks = tracks)

payload_json <- toJSON(payload, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null", digits = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: explorer
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# The interactive layer: R has computed everything above, and this embeds the
# result with a small amount of vanilla JavaScript to draw the field and handle
# clicks. No server and no Shiny -- the rendered HTML is fully standalone.
#
# Everything below is emitted inside a ```{=html} raw block. Without it Pandoc
# treats any line indented four or more spaces as a MARKDOWN CODE BLOCK, which
# is why the buttons first rendered as visible source text instead of controls.
# The raw fence passes the whole thing through verbatim; the HTML is also
# de-indented as a second line of defence.
cat('```{=html}\n')

cat('<style>
.px-wrap{background:#12181f;color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;
 font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
.px-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:290px 1fr 260px;gap:12px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.px-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.px-panel{background:#161f2b;border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.px-panel h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:#9fb0c0;
 text-transform:uppercase}
#px-list{max-height:560px;overflow-y:auto}
.px-ab{padding:6px 8px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12.5px;
 border-left:3px solid transparent;margin-bottom:2px}
.px-ab:hover{background:#22303f}
.px-ab.sel{background:#22303f;border-left-color:#ffc72c}
.px-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px}
.px-meta{color:#9fb0c0;font-size:11px}
.px-pos{color:#22c55e}.px-neg{color:#c8102e}
.px-ctrl{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.px-btn{background:#22303f;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 12px;
 font-weight:700;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.px-btn.p{background:#ffc72c;color:#000}
.px-stat{background:#22303f;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.px-stat .k{font-size:9.5px;color:#9fb0c0;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.px-stat .v{font-size:19px;font-weight:800}
.px-narr{font-size:14px;margin:6px 0}
</style>')

cat('<div class="px-wrap"><div class="px-grid">
<div class="px-panel"><h4>Plate appearances</h4><div id="px-list"></div></div>
<div class="px-panel"><h4 id="px-title">Field replay</h4>
<svg id="px-field" viewBox="0 0 640 470" style="width:100%;height:auto"></svg>
<div class="px-ctrl">
<button class="px-btn p" id="px-play">&#9654; Play</button>
<button class="px-btn" id="px-prev">&#9664; Prev</button>
<button class="px-btn" id="px-next">Next &#9654;</button>
<input type="range" id="px-scrub" min="0" max="1000" value="0" style="flex:1">
<span id="px-clock" style="color:#9fb0c0;font-size:11px"></span>
</div>
<div class="px-narr" id="px-narr"></div>
</div>
<div class="px-panel"><h4>The numbers</h4><div id="px-stats"></div></div>
</div></div>')

cat(paste0('<script>\nconst PX = ', payload_json, ';\n'))

cat('
const $ = function(i){ return document.getElementById(i); };
let sel = 0, t = 0, timer = null;

const VW=640, VH=470, MAXD=420;
function fx(x){ return VW/2 + (x/MAXD)*(VW/2-14); }
function fy(y){ return VH-24 - (y/MAXD)*(VH-48); }
const LBL={1:"P",2:"C",3:"1B",4:"2B",5:"3B",6:"SS",7:"LF",8:"CF",9:"RF",
           10:"BAT",11:"R1",12:"R2",13:"R3"};
function col(pid){ pid=+pid; if(pid<=2) return "#ffffff";
  if(pid<=6) return "#8fd4ff"; if(pid<=9) return "#ffd54a"; return "#ff7a90"; }

function fieldBase(){
  const H=[0,0],F=[63.64,63.64],S=[0,127.28],T=[-63.64,63.64];
  const P=function(p){ return fx(p[0])+","+fy(p[1]); };
  let s = "<rect width="+VW+" height="+VH+" fill=\\"#0b6b3a\\"/>";
  s += "<polygon points=\\""+P(H)+" "+P(F)+" "+P(S)+" "+P(T)+"\\" fill=\\"#8a5a2b\\" opacity=\\".5\\"/>";
  s += "<polyline points=\\""+P(H)+" "+P(F)+" "+P(S)+" "+P(T)+" "+P(H)+"\\" fill=\\"none\\" stroke=\\"#fff\\" stroke-width=\\"1.8\\"/>";
  [F,T].forEach(function(b){ const n=Math.hypot(b[0],b[1]);
    s += "<line x1="+fx(0)+" y1="+fy(0)+" x2="+fx(b[0]/n*MAXD*0.8)+" y2="+fy(b[1]/n*MAXD*0.8)+" stroke=\\"#fff\\" stroke-width=\\"1.3\\"/>"; });
  [F,S,T].forEach(function(b){ s += "<rect x="+(fx(b[0])-3)+" y="+(fy(b[1])-3)+" width=6 height=6 fill=\\"#fff\\"/>"; });
  s += "<circle cx="+fx(0)+" cy="+fy(60.5)+" r=8 fill=\\"#8a5a2b\\" stroke=\\"#fff\\"/>";
  return s;
}

function curTrack(){ return PX.tracks[String(PX.plays[sel].play)] || null; }

function draw(){
  const tr = curTrack(); let s = fieldBase();
  if(!tr){ $("px-field").innerHTML = s +
    "<text x=16 y=26 fill=\\"#fff\\" font-size=13>No tracking for this play</text>"; return; }
  const T = tr.t, dur = T[T.length-1] || 1, ms = Math.min(t, dur);
  let i = 0; while(i < T.length-1 && T[i+1] <= ms) i++;
  const j = Math.min(i+1, T.length-1);
  const span = (T[j]-T[i]) || 1, f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,(ms-T[i])/span));
  const lp = function(a,b){ return a + (b-a)*f; };

  let d = "";
  for(let k=0;k<=i;k++){ d += (k?"L":"M") + fx(tr.bx[k]) + "," + fy(tr.by[k]); }
  if(d) s += "<path d=\\""+d+"\\" fill=\\"none\\" stroke=\\"#fff\\" stroke-width=1.5 opacity=.6 stroke-dasharray=\\"3 3\\"/>";

  for(const pid in tr.players){
    const p = tr.players[pid];
    const x = lp(p.x[i], p.x[j]), y = lp(p.y[i], p.y[j]);
    s += "<circle cx="+fx(x)+" cy="+fy(y)+" r=5.5 fill=\\""+col(pid)+"\\" stroke=\\"#0a1017\\" stroke-width=1.2/>";
    s += "<text x="+fx(x)+" y="+(fy(y)-8)+" fill=\\""+col(pid)+"\\" font-size=8.5 text-anchor=\\"middle\\" font-weight=700>"+(LBL[pid]||pid)+"</text>";
  }
  const bx = lp(tr.bx[i], tr.bx[j]), by = lp(tr.by[i], tr.by[j]),
        bz = lp(tr.bz[i], tr.bz[j]);
  const r = 4 + Math.max(0, Math.min(9, bz))*0.55;
  s += "<circle cx="+fx(bx)+" cy="+fy(by)+" r="+r+" fill=\\"#fff\\" stroke=\\"#c8102e\\" stroke-width=1.4/>";

  if(tr.events){
    const names = {1:"PITCH",4:"CONTACT",2:"FIELDED",3:"THROW",5:"END OF PLAY",
                   10:"OFF THE WALL",11:"HOME RUN",16:"BOUNCE"};
    const ev = [].concat(tr.events.t ? tr.events.t.map(function(tt,k){
      return {t:tt, code:tr.events.code[k]}; }) : tr.events);
    ev.forEach(function(e){
      if(Math.abs(e.t-ms) < 240 && names[e.code])
        s += "<text x="+(VW/2)+" y=30 fill=\\"#ffc72c\\" font-size=17 font-weight=800 text-anchor=\\"middle\\">"+names[e.code]+"</text>";
    });
  }
  $("px-field").innerHTML = s;
  $("px-clock").textContent = (ms/1000).toFixed(1)+"s";
  $("px-scrub").value = Math.round(1000*ms/dur);
}

function statBox(k,v){ return "<div class=\\"px-stat\\"><div class=\\"k\\">"+k+"</div><div class=\\"v\\">"+v+"</div></div>"; }

function render(){
  const p = PX.plays[sel];
  $("px-title").textContent = p.situation;
  const wpa = (p.wpa*100);
  let words = p.batter + " — " + String(p.outcome).replace(/_/g," ");
  if(p.runs > 0) words += ", " + p.runs + " in";
  words += ". Win probability " + (wpa>=0?"+":"") + wpa.toFixed(0) + "%.";
  $("px-narr").textContent = words;

  let h = statBox("Win probability added",(wpa>=0?"+":"")+wpa.toFixed(0)+"%")
        + statBox("Leverage", p.leverage.toFixed(2)+"x")
        + statBox("Score", PX.meta.away+" "+p.away+" — "+PX.meta.home+" "+p.home);
  if(p.pitch_velo)  h += statBox("Pitch velocity", p.pitch_velo+" mph");
  if(p.exit_velo)   h += statBox("Exit velocity", p.exit_velo+" mph");
  if(p.launch!=null)h += statBox("Launch angle", p.launch+"&deg;");
  if(p.carry)       h += statBox("Carry", p.carry+" ft");
  if(p.fielder)     h += statBox("Fielded by", p.fielder);
  if(p.route_ft)    h += statBox("Ground covered", p.route_ft+" ft");
  if(p.time_to_ball)h += statBox("Time to ball", p.time_to_ball+" s");
  if(p.closing_mph) h += statBox("Closing speed", p.closing_mph+" mph");
  if(p.transfer_s)  h += statBox("Transfer", p.transfer_s+" s");
  if(p.sprint_mph)  h += statBox("Sprint speed", p.sprint_mph+" mph");
  $("px-stats").innerHTML = h;

  $("px-list").innerHTML = PX.plays.map(function(q,k){
    const w = q.wpa*100;
    return "<div class=\\"px-ab"+(k===sel?" sel":"")+"\\" onclick=\\"pxPick("+k+")\\">"
      + "<div class=\\"px-row\\"><b>"+q.batter+"</b><span class=\\""+(w>=0?"px-pos":"px-neg")+"\\">"
      + (w>=0?"+":"")+w.toFixed(0)+"%</span></div>"
      + "<div class=\\"px-row\\"><span class=\\"px-meta\\">"+(q.half==="Top"?"\\u25B2":"\\u25BC")+q.inning
      + " &middot; "+String(q.outcome).replace(/_/g," ")+"</span>"
      + "<span class=\\"px-meta\\">LI "+q.leverage.toFixed(1)+"</span></div></div>";
  }).join("");
  const el = $("px-list").children[sel]; if(el) el.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"});
  draw();
}

function pxPick(k){ sel = Math.max(0, Math.min(PX.plays.length-1, k)); t = 0; stop(); render(); }
function stop(){ if(timer){ clearInterval(timer); timer=null; $("px-play").innerHTML="&#9654; Play"; } }
$("px-play").onclick = function(){
  if(timer){ stop(); return; }
  const tr = curTrack(); if(!tr) return;
  const dur = tr.t[tr.t.length-1];
  if(t >= dur) t = 0;
  $("px-play").innerHTML = "&#10074;&#10074; Pause";
  timer = setInterval(function(){
    t += 40; const d = curTrack().t[curTrack().t.length-1];
    if(t >= d){ t = d; draw(); stop(); return; } draw(); }, 40);
};
$("px-next").onclick = function(){ pxPick(sel+1); };
$("px-prev").onclick = function(){ pxPick(sel-1); };
$("px-scrub").oninput = function(e){
  const tr = curTrack(); if(!tr) return;
  t = tr.t[tr.t.length-1] * (+e.target.value/1000); draw();
};
pxPick(0);
</script>')

# Close the raw-HTML fence opened at the top of this chunk.
cat('\n```\n')
```

---

# Notes on method

**What is deliberately not modelled.** The data has no umpire calls, so there is
no supervised "called strike probability"; no steal or caught-stealing labels,
so no steal probability; and no spin rate, which cannot be recovered from
positional tracking. Only quantities the tracking actually supports are shown.

**Known limitation.** Reaching on an error and a fielder's choice are not
distinguishable from a single by occupancy alone, which is why hits run about
10% above the real rate.

**Reproducing this document.**

```bash
quarto render SMT_Play_Explorer.qmd
```

Set `SMT_DATA_ROOT` first if this file is not inside the challenge folder. The
rendered HTML is fully standalone — the tracking data, charts and interactive
explorer are all embedded, so it can be emailed or opened offline.
